en.headline: MTR to use world-first skidding method for Hung Shui Kiu Station
en.dek: Two 10,000-tonne station structures will be built beside the Tuen Ma Line viaduct and slid into place next year, limiting service disruption to at most two days each time.
body: The MTR Corporation said on Friday it will become the first railway operator in the world to adopt a skidding construction method on an operating railway viaduct when it builds the new Hung Shui Kiu Station on the Tuen Ma Line.

Located on an elevated viaduct between Tin Shui Wai and Siu Hong stations, the station will be built as two separate 210-metre-long, 15-metre-wide structures, each weighing around 10,000 tonnes. Capital Works Director Carl Devlin said Tuen Ma Line services will face no more than two days of disruption during each skidding operation next year, when the prefabricated pieces are guided into place along a track system.

The stations that will face brief service disruptions are Tuen Mun, Siu Hong and Tin Shui Wai. The two largest station structures will be progressively skidded under strict controls from an assembly location about 30 metres away from the viaduct until they meet the existing structure exactly. The operations are scheduled for the late first quarter and the third quarter of next year.

Devlin said on-site trials will take place beforehand, leaving no room for error, and a full suite of testing and follow-up work will follow installation. Building away from the existing tracks allows most construction during normal service hours, reducing reliance on the restrictive overnight work window and cutting risks associated with in-situ work on an active viaduct. Hung Shui Kiu Station is expected to open in 2030.

zh.headline: 港鐵洪水橋站全球首用「滑移施工」 明年兩次短暫影響屯馬綫
zh.dek: 兩座各重約1萬噸的車站結構將在屯馬綫高架橋旁預製，明年分兩次滑移就位，每次服務受影響不多於兩日。
body: 港鐵公司周五表示，將在興建屯馬綫新洪水橋站時，全球首次在營運中的鐵路高架橋上採用「滑移施工」方法。
新站位於天水圍與兆康站之間的高架橋上，將以兩座各長210米、寬15米、重約1萬噸的獨立結構興建。資本工程總監Carl Devlin表示，明年每次滑移作業期間，屯馬綫服務受影響時間不多於兩日，預製構件會沿軌道系統滑移至最終位置。
短暫受影響的車站包括屯門、兆康及天水圍。兩座最大型車站結構將在嚴格監控下，由距離高架橋約30米的組裝位置逐步滑移至與現有橋體精確接合。有關作業分別定於明年首季後期及第三季進行。
Devlin強調會先進行現場試驗，不容出錯，安裝後亦會全面測試及跟進。在現有軌道以外施工，讓大部分工程可在正常服務時間進行，大幅減少依賴夜間「黃金兩小時」工作窗，亦降低在運作中高架橋進行現場施工的風險。洪水橋站預計2030年啟用。
